verdict.rationale: Airbyte's Connector Builder (low-code YAML) plus its AI Assistant explicitly automate drafting a new connector by prefilling and configuring fields/sections directly in the builder UI, matching the 'AI drafts a working connector, human reviews and ships' workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that AI Assistant specifically infers auth schemes, pagination logic, and stream definitions from raw API docs, and any independent/hands-on account confirming the AI-drafted connector actually worked end-to-end.
